name: karabo-device-development
description: Guidance for implementing, reviewing, debugging, and testing Karabo devices across the C++, bound-Python, and middlelayer APIs, including behavior-driven pytest and coverage analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Karabo devices with API-specific guidance.
interface.longDescription: Routes Karabo device work to detailed guidance for the classic C++, bound-Python, or asynchronous middlelayer API. Includes workflows for targeted pytest tests, regression tests accompanying implementation, failure diagnosis, fixtures, and behavior-driven coverage improvement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Implement, review, or test this Karabo device using the correct API and pytest guidance.
